Market (2026-10-08): crawlstone/tennis-scraper $0.006-0.008 per result (998 monthly users, Sofascore + Tennis Abstract), extractify-labs/flashscore-tennis-matches $0.001 per row (837), parseforge/tennisexplorer-scraper $0.0075 (140). match_row $0.002 includes odds and head-to-head; match_stats +$0.002 only when a stats block is attached. No start fee. No proxy: Flashscore feed and Tennisexplorer answered from Apify IPs in the 2026-10-08 probe.

match_row.eventDescription: One match with tournament, surface, players, status, winner, set and tiebreak scores, and average odds with implied probability and head-to-head where available. A run with no matches is free.

match_stats.eventDescription: The stats block on a match (aces, double faults, serve and return points won, break points, winners, unforced errors), per match and per set. Charged only when Match stats is on and the match has stats.
